description: Vasiljevic, Nikola and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The spreadsheet is an implemented update of the taxonomy and metadata vocabulary used in DTU Data for wind-energy datasets and collections. It continues the earlier IRPWind Open Data work, with explicit native citations to the prior report and the DTU FAIR project. The object is a semantic information resource for describing wind-research data, not a new measurement collection or a wind-flow simulator. It can help represent and locate inputs used by wind-energy modelling workflows. The record preserves the dated vocabulary release and does not imply that the current DTU portal still uses this exact version. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
